sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Astronomers reviewing archive data from the Hubble Space Telescope identified unrecognised chemical features in the white dwarf star HS 0209+0832. Using updated databases, researchers matched these features to niobium, indicating the presence of a second-generation planet formed from ejected stellar material.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: This discovery suggests that planetary systems can form around stellar remnants after a star dies, opening a new chapter in the study of planetary evolution.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Researchers plan to use the Hubble Space Telescope for the next several years to explore how common these second-generation planets are.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from his China Open semi-final against Novak Djokovic after hitting a spectator in the face with a ball. Trailing in the second set, Medvedev swiped at a ball in annoyance after it ricocheted off the back of the court. The ball hit a front-row spectator, who was helped out of the arena. Following discussions with the umpire and an ATP official, Medvedev was disqualified.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Defaults in tennis are rare and occur for code of conduct violations. Although players typically receive multiple warnings before disqualification, Medvedev's offence was severe enough for an instant default. Consequently, he loses his ranking points and prize money from Beijing. The incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding his on-court temper and emotional control.

gist: Google may expand its Call for Me AI feature to personal contacts.
Findings from an APK teardown show examples like calling family members.
Granular permissions could allow users to control Gemini app actions.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Google might expand its Call for Me AI feature beyond business calls. Android Authority discovered a Gemini Calling introductory screen in an APK teardown, showing examples such as calling relatives or friends to deliver quick messages.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The expansion could help users send quick messages to people who miss texts often or have landline phones. Additionally, granular permissions might let users control app capabilities and potentially opt out of receiving incoming automated calls.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: It remains uncertain if Google will publicly release this expansion or the granular app settings, as findings from APK teardowns do not guarantee a public launch.

fivew: Google may expand its Call for Me feature to personal contacts for quick messages.
To reach people who prefer phone calls, miss texts, or have landlines.
